decisions.reason: The existing message-684 MODIFY already records that the first mint contributes neither a randomly assigned ticket nor a referral commission when no earlier NFT holder exists.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already incorporates the first-mint exception into the leaderboard ticket-and-commission totals.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already states that no random $5 referral commission is awarded on the first mint when no earlier NFT holder exists.
The existing message-684 MODIFY already records the first-mint exception to the otherwise applicable $5 affiliate allocation.
The accepted exception applies only to the first mint without a referral code and does not alter commissions for mints using a valid referral code.
The first-mint ticket-allocation exception does not change how an actual prize winner receives a prize or is notified.
The client explicitly treats the no-holder first-mint case as a one-off with no forward impact, so no About-page copy change is necessarily required.
The decision concerns reward allocation for the first primary mint without a referral code and does not alter secondary-sale royalty behavior.
The accepted exception is explicitly a one-off with no future impact, so the source does not necessarily require revising the general FAQ description of no-code rewards.
The first-mint allocation exception does not change fiat buyers' wallet provisioning, dashboard access, or access to rewards they actually receive.
The source accepts a historical first-mint edge case and does not require changing the general valid or no/invalid referral-code feedback.
Whether the first mint receives a randomly allocated ticket or commission does not change NFT transfer semantics for books, referral codes, badges, or tickets.
